title: XYvirtual WEB License File v1 (.rvlic)
description: Offline-verifiable contract evidence. Signature covers the payload BYTES, so the envelope is verified before payload is parsed. See docs/contracts/LICENSE_FILE.md and ADR-0007.

payload.description: Strict padded standard Base64 of the payload UTF-8 bytes. Decoded and signature-checked BEFORE JSON.parse.

sig64.description: 64 bytes. Verifiers MUST also re-encode and compare to reject non-canonical Base64.

pub32.description: 32 bytes. Verifiers MUST also re-encode and compare to reject non-canonical Base64.

cert.description: Optional RV-KEY-V1 delegation. Absent means `sig` is verified with the compiled root key.

sig.description: Root-key signature over "RV-KEY-V1" || pub || u32LE(orgUtf8.length) || orgUtf8, org NFC-normalized.

payloadDocument.description: The decoded payload. additionalProperties is true on purpose: unknown fields are preserved, never rejected.

graceDays.description: Days past notAfter that stay fully functional. Absent means 30. Values above 180 are clamped, not rejected.

features.description: Stable feature ids. Unknown ids are ignored, never an error.

instant.description: RFC 3339 UTC with a literal Z. Local offsets are rejected so two readers never disagree.

binding.description: Audit assertions, not locks. A mismatch degrades to the `mismatch` state and never removes capability.

installId.description: Compared against deployment config license.installId, which is self-asserted by the host.

items.description: Lowercase host. One leading '*.' wildcard consumes exactly one label. Loopback names match only when listed explicitly.

limits.description: Contract terms recorded for audit. NOT enforced client-side: a browser cannot observe other browsers.
